tooltips.s3AccessKeyId: Leave both this and Secret Access Key blank to authenticate via the server's own IAM identity instead (an EC2 instance profile role, an ECS task role, or an IRSA-bound service account) — recommended when running on AWS infrastructure that already has one attached.
tooltips.s3SecretAccessKey: Leave both this and Access Key ID blank to authenticate via the server's own IAM identity instead (an EC2 instance profile role, an ECS task role, or an IRSA-bound service account) — recommended when running on AWS infrastructure that already has one attached.
tooltips.s3Endpoint: Override for S3-compatible non-AWS backends (e.g. MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi). Leave blank to use AWS's default endpoint for the selected region.
tooltips.s3ForcePathStyle: Enable for most self-hosted S3-compatible backends (e.g. MinIO), which typically require path-style addressing instead of AWS's default virtual-hosted-style.
tooltips.s3VerifyTls: Disabling this rejects nothing over TLS enforcement and is intended only for local development against a plain-HTTP MinIO instance. Leave enabled in production.
